```csharp
(OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.IMobileFlow mainFlow) => {
    
    /*** creating IMobileScreen 'Catalog' ***/
    var catalog2 = mainFlow.CreateScreen("Catalog");
    var eSpace = mainFlow.GetESpace();
    var registered = eSpace.SystemRoles.OfType<OutSystems.Model.Logic.ISystemRole>().Named("Registered");
    catalog2.Roles.Add(registered);
    catalog2.Description = null; // default value
    catalog2.PageName = "catalog";
    catalog2.SetTitle("\"Catalog\"");
    catalog2.OnDestroy.Destination = null; // default value
    catalog2.OnReady.Destination = null; // default value
    catalog2.OnRender.Destination = null; // default value
    
    var openItem = catalog2.CreateScreenAction("OpenItem");
    openItem.Description = null; // default value
    
    var startNode = openItem.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IStartNode>();
    
    var getCatalog = openItem.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IExecuteServerActionNode>("GetCatalog");
    var getCatalog2 = eSpace.ServerActions.Named("GetCatalog");
    getCatalog.Action = getCatalog2;
    getCatalog.HorizontalPosition = 3200;
    getCatalog.VerticalPosition = 3200;
    startNode.Target = getCatalog;
    
    var formatDate = openItem.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IExecuteClientActionNode>("FormatDate");
    var formatDate2 = eSpace.ClientActions.Named("FormatDate");
    formatDate.Action = formatDate2;
    formatDate.HorizontalPosition = 3200;
    formatDate.VerticalPosition = 4100;
    getCatalog.Target = formatDate;
    
    var endNode = openItem.CreateNode<OutSystems.Model.Logic.Nodes.IEndNode>();
    formatDate.Target = endNode;
    catalog2.OnInitialize.Destination = null; // default value
    
    var layoutMainInstance = catalog2.CreateWidget<OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.Widgets.IMobileBlockInstanceWidget>();
    layoutMainInstance.CustomStyle = null; // default value
    var mOD_DEMO_Layouts = eSpace.References.Named("MOD_DEMO_Layouts");
    var demoLayouts = mOD_DEMO_Layouts.MobileFlows.Named("DemoLayouts");
    var layoutMain = demoLayouts.Nodes.OfType<OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.IMobileBlockSignature>().Named("LayoutMain");
    layoutMainInstance.SourceBlock = layoutMain;
    var hasFixedHeader = layoutMain.InputParameters.Named("HasFixedHeader");
    layoutMainInstance.SetArgumentValue(hasFixedHeader, "True");
    
    var placeholderContentWidget = layoutMainInstance.PlaceholdersContent.FirstOrDefault(p => p.Placeholder?.Name == "MainContent");
    var tileInstance = placeholderContentWidget.CreateWidget<OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.Widgets.IMobileBlockInstanceWidget>();
    tileInstance.CustomStyle = null; // default value
    var commonFlow = eSpace.MobileFlows.Named("Common");
    var tile = commonFlow.Nodes.OfType<OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.IMobileBlock>().Named("Tile");
    tileInstance.SourceBlock = tile;
    var eventHandler1 = tileInstance.EventHandlers.FirstOrDefault(e => e.Event.Name == "Clicked");
    eventHandler1.Handler = openItem;
    var cardInstance = placeholderContentWidget.CreateWidget<OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.Widgets.IMobileBlockInstanceWidget>();
    cardInstance.CustomStyle = null; // default value
    var demoPatternsFlow = eSpace.MobileFlows.Named("DemoPatterns");
    var card = demoPatternsFlow.Nodes.OfType<OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile.IMobileBlock>().Named("Card");
    cardInstance.SourceBlock = card;
}
```
